title: Inhibition of colorectal cancer aggressiveness by Oleanolic acid through Nur77 degradation.
authors: Deng, Shan; Liu, Yuping; Liu, Xiyu; Yu, Jialin; Chen, Yan; Huo, Jiege
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究齐墩果酸通过分子对接和MD模拟结合Nur77并促进其泛素化降解抑制结直肠癌，虽涉及蛋白-小分子互作模拟，但非TF-DNA体系，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is the second primary malignancy in China with tough treatment challenge. Although Oleanolic acid (OA) protects against various cancers, its mechanisms in CRC are not well defined. Our previously study showed that Nur77 has CRC promoting effect. Thus, we investigated the roles of OA as Nur77 ligand and the regulatory effects on Nur77 degradation in CRC progression. METHODS: The proliferative and metastatic phenotypes of OA was examined by CCK-8, EdU, organoid culture, would healing and transwell assays, respectively. Epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) properties were assessed by Western blotting (WB). The interaction between OA and Nur77 was monitored by molecular docking and Molecular Dynamics stimulation (MD). Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG) and Gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA) were employed to screen the downstream regulatory pathways. The half-time and proteasome degradation of Nur77 were treated with cycloheximide (CHX) and MG132. Co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP) and ubiquitination assays were employed to detect direct association between Nur77 and PPARgamma. Rescued experiments were performed by Nur77 agonist Cytosporone B (Csn-B) treatment. The findings were verified in xenograft and in situ models. RESULTS: For the first time, we found the effect of OA on ubiquitination degradation. OA inhibited CRC cell survival and EMT phenotypes by suppressing Nur77. Mechanistically, OA directly bind to Nur77 and facilitated the ubiquitin degradation of Nur77. During this process, PPARgamma acted as the ubiquitination activator via interacting with Nur77. Rescued experiments revealed that OA-induced inhibition was recovered by replenishing Nur77. In both subcutaneous and orthotopic CRC models, OA exhibited significant anti-tumor effect together with Nur77 inhibition. CONCLUSION: We revealed a new regulatory effect of OA in CRC tumorigenesis via PPARgamma-mediated Nur77 ubiquitin degradation.
abstract_zh: 背景：结直肠癌（CRC）是中国第二大恶性肿瘤，治疗挑战严峻。尽管齐墩果酸（OA）对多种癌症具有保护作用，但其在结直肠癌中的机制尚未明确。我们前期研究表明Nur77具有促进结直肠癌的作用。因此，我们研究了OA作为Nur77配体的作用及其对Nur77降解在结直肠癌进展中的调控效应。方法：通过CCK-8、EdU、类器官培养、划痕愈合和transwell实验分别检测OA的增殖和转移表型。通过蛋白质印迹法（WB）评估上皮-间质转化（EMT）特性。通过分子对接和分子动力学模拟（MD）监测OA与Nur77之间的相互作用。采用京都基因与基因组百科全书（KEGG）和基因集富集分析（GSEA）筛选下游调控通路。使用环己酰亚胺（CHX）和MG132处理Nur77的半衰期和蛋白酶体降解。采用免疫共沉淀（Co-IP）和泛素化实验检测Nur77与PPARgamma之间的直接关联。通过Nur77激动剂Cytosporone B（Csn-B）处理进行拯救实验。研究结果在异种移植和原位模型中验证。结果：我们首次发现OA对泛素化降解的作用。OA通过抑制Nur77抑制结直肠癌细胞存活和EMT表型。机制上，OA直接结合Nur77并促进Nur77的泛素降解。在此过程中，PPARgamma通过与Nur77相互作用充当泛素化激活因子。拯救实验表明，补充Nur77可恢复OA诱导的抑制作用。在皮下和原位结直肠癌模型中，OA均表现出显著的抗肿瘤效应，同时伴随Nur77抑制。结论：我们揭示了OA通过PPARgamma介导的Nur77泛素降解在结直肠癌肿瘤发生中的新调控作用。
